summaryZh: Gerry Boss Laboratory 开发维生素 B12 类似物 cobinamide，用于探索多种化学中毒和辐射细胞损伤的治疗。另研究氨基酸供应及 PI3K/Akt 通路如何调节嘌呤核苷酸合成。

evidence.quote: The first is developing the vitamin B12 analog cobinamide as a new therapy for poisoning by multiple toxic chemicals as well as radiation-induced cell damage.
The second major area of research is studying the regulation of purine nucleotide synthesis by amino acid availability and the phosphatidylinosol 3-kinase/Akt pathway.
